request.prompt:
You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |
| cash_at_beginning | CF / Cash flows | Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of year | Opening cash. |
| dividends | EQ / Retained earnings | Dividends declared | Dividends declared to shareholders in the year, as a positive number. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

## What extract(path) must return: a JSON-serialisable dict with these keys
- "entity_code": the register code of the entity the workbook belongs to.
- "source_entity_name": the entity name as written in the workbook.
- "currency": the ISO code of the amounts (it must match the register).
- "unit": 1, 1000 or 1000000, meaning what one unit of the values you return stands for. Keep the workbook's
  own unit when it is one of these; otherwise convert (for example lakhs to thousands).
- "period_end": {"cy": "YYYY-MM-DD", "py": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, the balance-sheet dates of the two years.
- "fields": for every one of the 33 keys, {"cy": LINE, "py": LINE} with
  LINE = {"value": number, "cells": [{"sheet": sheet name, "cell": "D12", "factor": number}, ...]}.
  value must equal the sum of factor x (the number in each cited cell). factor carries any sign change and unit
  conversion (for example -1, 1 or 100). A line that does not appear in the workbook has value 0 and no cells.
- "source_totals": the totals and subtotals printed in the workbook, so they can be checked. Each is
  {"sheet", "cell", "year": "cy" or "py", "factor", "formula"}, where factor x the printed number must equal the
  formula, an expression over the template keys and totals above using + and - only (for example
  "distribution_costs + administrative_expenses"). For a subtotal that matches no template expression use
  {"sheet", "cell", "year", "factor", "sum_of": [cells as in LINE]} instead of "formula".
- "ignored": numbers in the workbook you deliberately do not use, each {"sheet", "range": "C5:C40" (or "cell": "C5"),
  "reason"} with a specific reason (budget column, another entity, note references, superseded draft, ...).
- "source_exceptions": problems in the workbook itself, each {"check": the check id, "difference": the difference
  the check reports, "explanation": text}. Leave it empty when the workbook is consistent.
- "notes": a few sentences on decisions a reviewer should know about.

## Checks that will run on your output
- every cited cell exists and holds a number, and each line's value equals its cells times their factors;
- revenue, costs, assets, liabilities, share capital and dividends are not negative;
- the statements are not empty;
- every entry in source_totals agrees with the template (check id "T <sheet>!<cell> <year>");
- the balance sheet balances ("R1 balance cy", "R1 balance py"); the cash flow ends at balance-sheet cash
  ("R2 cash_at_end cy", "R2 cash_at_end py"); opening cash equals last year's balance-sheet cash ("R3 opening cash cy");
  retained earnings roll forward, prior + profit - dividends = current ("R4 retained earnings cy");
- coverage: in every column you take amounts from, each number below the first amount you use must be used,
  listed in source_totals or listed in ignored.

## Rules for the code
- Python 3 standard library and openpyxl only. Load with openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True).
- Define extract(path) -> dict. Never write, save, rename or delete any file; no network; no subprocess; no printing.
- Read every amount from the cells in code. Do not type amounts from the workbook into the code.
- Find rows by their labels rather than fixed row numbers where you can, so the adapter survives a moved row.
- If the workbook itself is inconsistent (a printed total does not add up, or the statements do not tie), keep the
  workbook's numbers exactly as they are and declare a source_exception for that check. Never change, plug or force
  a number to make a check pass.

```python
    "deferred_tax_liabilities": [("BS", "Deferred taxation", None, 1)],
    "share_capital": [("BS", "Called up share capital", None, 1),
                      ("BS", "Share premium account", None, 1)],
    "retained_earnings": [("BS", "Profit and loss account", None, 1)],
    "other_reserves": [("BS", "Other reserves", None, 1)],
    "net_cash_operating": [("CF", "Net cash from operating activities", None, 1)],
    "net_cash_investing": [("CF", "Net cash from investing activities", None, 1)],
    "net_cash_financing": [("CF", "Net cash from financing activities", None, 1)],
    "fx_effect_on_cash": [("CF", "Effect of foreign exchange rate changes", None, 1)],
    "cash_at_beginning": [("CF", "Cash at beginning of year", None, 1)],
    "dividends": [("Reserves", "Dividends paid on equity shares", None, -1)],
}

# (sheet, label, section, formula) printed totals; factor 1 throughout
TOTALS = [
    ("P&L", "Gross profit", None, "gross_profit"),
    ("P&L", "Operating profit", None, "operating_profit"),
    ("P&L", "Profit before taxation", None, "profit_before_tax"),
    ("P&L", "Profit for the financial year", None, "profit_for_year"),
    ("BS", "Total fixed assets", None, "property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments"),
    ("BS", "Total debtors", None, "trade_receivables + other_current_assets + deferred_tax_assets"),
    ("BS", "Total current assets", None, "total_current_assets + deferred_tax_assets"),
    ("BS", "Total creditors due within one year", None, "total_current_liabilities"),
    ("BS", "Net current assets", None, "total_current_assets + deferred_tax_assets - total_current_liabilities"),
    ("BS", "Total assets less current liabilities", None, "total_assets - total_current_liabilities"),
    ("BS", "Net assets", None, "total_assets - total_liabilities"),
    ("BS", "Shareholders' funds", None, "total_equity"),
    ("CF", "Net increase/(decrease) in cash", None, "net_change_in_cash"),
    ("CF", "Cash at end of year", None, "cash_at_end"),
    ("Reserves", "At end of year", None, "retained_earnings"),
]


def _norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(s)).strip().casefold()


def _norm_name(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", str(s).casefold())
    words = [{"ltd": "limited", "inc": "inc", "co": "co"}.get(w, w) for w in s.split()]
    return " ".join(words)


def _is_num(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)


def _year_columns(ws):
    """Find the columns whose header is a 4-digit year; larger year = cy."""
    found = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=8):
        for c in row:
            v = c.value
            if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
                v = str(int(v))
            if isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r"\s*(19|20)\d\d\s*", v):
                found.append((int(v), c.column_letter, c.row))
        if len(found) >= 2:
            break
    found.sort(reverse=True)
    return found[0][1], found[1][1], found[0][2]


def _find_row(ws, label, after=None, label_col="B"):
    start = 1
    if after is not None:
        start = _find_row(ws, after, None, label_col) + 1
    target = _norm(label)
    for r in range(start, ws.max_row + 1):
        v = ws[f"{label_col}{r}"].value
        if v is not None and _norm(v) == target:
            return r
    raise KeyError(f"label {label!r} not found in sheet {ws.title!r}")


def extract(path):
    wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
    cols = {name: _year_columns(wb[name]) for name in wb.sheetnames}

    # entity
    raw_name = str(wb["BS"]["B1"].value).strip()
    code = None
    for c, (nm, _cur) in REGISTER.items():
        if _norm_name(nm) == _norm_name(raw_name):
            code = c
            break
    if code is None:
        raise ValueError(f"entity {raw_name!r} not in register")
    currency = REGISTER[code][1]

    # unit
    hdr_row = cols["BS"][2] + 1
    unit_txt = str(wb["BS"][f"{cols['BS'][0]}{hdr_row}"].value or "")
    if "'000" in unit_txt or "000" in unit_txt and "000000" not in unit_txt:
        unit = 1000
    elif re.search(r"million|mn|'m|m$", unit_txt, re.I):
        unit = 1000000
    else:
        unit = 1

    # period end
    title = str(wb["BS"]["B2"].value)
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})", title)
    d, mon, yr = int(m.group(1)), MONTHS[m.group(2).lower()], int(m.group(3))
    cy_date = _dt.date(yr, mon, d)
    try:
        py_date = _dt.date(yr - 1, mon, d)
    except ValueError:
        py_date = _dt.date(yr - 1, mon, d - 1)

    def colof(sheet, year):
        return cols[sheet][0] if year == "cy" else cols[sheet][1]

    def cell_ref(sheet, label, after, year):
        ws = wb[sheet]
        r = _find_row(ws, label, after)
        return f"{colof(sheet, year)}{r}"

    fields = {k: {"cy": {"value": 0, "cells": []}, "py": {"value": 0, "cells": []}} for k in KEYS}
    for key, parts in FIELDS.items():
        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            cells, total = [], 0
            for sheet, label, after, factor in parts:
                ref = cell_ref(sheet, label, after, year)
                val = wb[sheet][ref].value
                cells.append({"sheet": sheet, "cell": ref, "factor": factor})
                total += factor * val
            fields[key][year] = {"value": total, "cells": cells}

    source_totals = []
    for sheet, label, after, formula in TOTALS:
        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            source_totals.append({
                "sheet": sheet,
                "cell": cell_ref(sheet, label, after, year),
                "year": year,
                "factor": 1,
                "formula": formula,
            })

    ignored = []
    # note-reference column
    for name in wb.sheetnames:
        ws = wb[name]
        for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            v = ws[f"C{r}"].value
            if _is_num(v):
                ignored.append({"sheet": name, "cell": f"C{r}",
                                "reason": "note reference number, not an amount"})
    # reserves movement rows not needed as separate inputs
    rs = wb["Reserves"]
    r_open = _find_row(rs, "At beginning of year")
    r_prof = _find_row(rs, "Profit for the financial year")
    for year in ("cy", "py"):
        c = colof("Reserves", year)
        ignored.append({"sheet": "Reserves", "cell": f"{c}{r_open}",
                        "reason": "opening reserve balance; equals prior-year closing retained earnings already taken from the balance sheet, used only in the roll-forward"})
        ignored.append({"sheet": "Reserves", "cell": f"{c}{r_prof}",
                        "reason": "profit for the year, duplicate of the profit and loss account figure (profit is derived by the template)"})

    return {
        "entity_code": code,
        "source_entity_name": raw_name,
        "currency": currency,
        "unit": unit,
        "period_end": {"cy": cy_date.isoformat(), "py": py_date.isoformat()},
        "fields": fields,
        "source_totals": source_totals,
        "ignored": ignored,
        "source_exceptions": [],
        "notes": (
            "Workbook title 'TARNWELL ENGINEERING LTD' matched to TW-UK02 Tarnwell Engineering Limited "
            "(not the Services company). Amounts are in GBP thousands and kept as-is. Source shows costs "
            "and tax as negatives, so cost of sales, distribution, administrative, finance costs and tax "
            "carry factor -1; 'Other operating income' is already signed (net expense) and keeps factor 1. "
            "Deferred tax asset sits inside debtors in the source and is moved to deferred tax assets, so "
            "the printed Total debtors and Total current assets are tied via formulas that add it back. "
            "Prepayments and other debtors go to other current assets; overdraft and current bank loans to "
            "current borrowings; accruals and other taxation/social security to other current liabilities; "
            "share capital and share premium are combined. Dividends come from the reserves note with "
            "factor -1. All printed totals and cross-statement checks tie, so no source exceptions."
        ),
    }
```

I checked every printed total and the cross-statement ties by hand against the figures you pasted, and all of them agree, so `source_exceptions` is empty. I did not run the adapter.

- **Entity:** The workbook's "TARNWELL ENGINEERING LTD" is matched to TW-UK02, Tarnwell Engineering Limited, not the Services company. Amounts are in £'000.
- **Signs:** The source shows costs and tax as negatives, so those lines carry factor -1. "Other operating income" is already a signed net figure (a net expense of 243), so it keeps factor 1. Dividends are read from the Reserves sheet with factor -1.
- **Deferred tax asset:** The source shows it inside debtors, so it is moved to `deferred_tax_assets`. The printed "Total debtors" and "Total current assets" are tied with formulas that add it back.
- **Cell lookup:** Rows are found by label, using the section heading to tell the two "Bank loans" rows apart. Year columns are found from the headers.

request.prompt:
You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |
| cash_at_beginning | CF / Cash flows | Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of year | Opening cash. |
| dividends | EQ / Retained earnings | Dividends declared | Dividends declared to shareholders in the year, as a positive number. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

## What extract(path) must return: a JSON-serialisable dict with these keys
- "entity_code": the register code of the entity the workbook belongs to.
- "source_entity_name": the entity name as written in the workbook.
- "currency": the ISO code of the amounts (it must match the register).
- "unit": 1, 1000 or 1000000, meaning what one unit of the values you return stands for. Keep the workbook's

```python
import re
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter


def _norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(s)).strip().lower()


def extract(path):
    wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)

    def rows_of(ws):
        d = {}
        for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            v = ws.cell(r, 1).value
            if isinstance(v, str):
                d.setdefault(_norm(v), r)
        return d

    rows = {n: rows_of(wb[n]) for n in ("IS", "SOFP", "SCF")}

    def row(sheet, label):
        return rows[sheet][_norm(label)]

    # Year columns from the header row of the IS sheet
    ws_is = wb["IS"]
    hdr = {}
    for c in range(2, ws_is.max_column + 1):
        v = ws_is.cell(5, c).value
        m = re.search(r"(20\d\d)", str(v)) if v is not None else None
        if m:
            hdr[int(m.group(1))] = c
    cy_year = max(hdr)
    col = {"cy": get_column_letter(hdr[cy_year]), "py": get_column_letter(hdr[cy_year - 1])}

    head = str(ws_is.cell(5, hdr[cy_year]).value)
    unit = 1000 if "000" in head else (1000000 if re.search(r"m(n|illion)?\b", head, re.I) else 1)

    # Period end from the title line of the balance sheet
    title = str(wb["SOFP"]["A3"].value)
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]+) (\d{4})", title)
    d_cy = datetime.strptime(" ".join(m.groups()), "%d %B %Y")
    d_py = d_cy.replace(year=d_cy.year - 1)
    period_end = {"cy": d_cy.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "py": d_py.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}

    def val(sheet, cell):
        v = wb[sheet][cell].value
        return v

    def cellref(sheet, label, yr):
        return "%s%d" % (col[yr], row(sheet, label))

    # key -> list of (sheet, label, factor)
    spec = {
        "revenue": [("IS", "Sales", 1)],
        "cost_of_sales": [("IS", "Cost of goods sold", 1)],
        "distribution_costs": [("IS", "Selling and distribution expenses", 1)],
        "administrative_expenses": [
            ("IS", "Administrative salaries", 1),
            ("IS", "Office premises costs", 1),
            ("IS", "Other administrative expenses", 1),
        ],
        "other_operating_income": [("IS", "Other gains and losses (net)", 1)],
        "finance_income": [("IS", "Interest received", 1)],
        "finance_costs": [("IS", "Finance costs", 1)],
        "income_tax_expense": [("IS", "Tax on profit", 1)],
        "property_plant_equipment": [("SOFP", "Tangible assets", 1)],
        "right_of_use_assets": [("SOFP", "Leased assets (right of use)", 1)],
        "intangible_assets": [("SOFP", "Intangible assets", 1)],
        "investments": [],
        "deferred_tax_assets": [("SOFP", "Deferred tax assets", 1)],
        "inventories": [("SOFP", "Inventories", 1)],
        "trade_receivables": [("SOFP", "Trade debtors", 1)],
        "other_current_assets": [("SOFP", "Other receivables and prepayments", 1)],
        "cash_and_cash_equivalents": [("SOFP", "Cash", 1)],
        "trade_payables": [("SOFP", "Accounts payable", 1)],
        "other_current_liabilities": [("SOFP", "Accruals and other payables", 1)],
        "current_borrowings": [("SOFP", "Short-term borrowings", 1)],
        "current_tax_payable": [("SOFP", "Income tax payable", 1)],
        "non_current_borrowings": [("SOFP", "Loans due after one year", 1)],
        "provisions": [("SOFP", "Provisions", 1)],
        "deferred_tax_liabilities": [("SOFP", "Deferred tax liabilities", 1)],
        "share_capital": [("SOFP", "Share capital", 1)],
        "retained_earnings": [("SOFP", "Accumulated profits", 1)],
        "other_reserves": [("SOFP", "Other reserves", 1)],
        "net_cash_operating": [("SCF", "Net cash from operating activities", 1)],
        "net_cash_investing": [("SCF", "Net cash used in investing activities", 1)],
        "net_cash_financing": [("SCF", "Net cash from financing activities", 1)],
        "fx_effect_on_cash": [("SCF", "Foreign exchange differences on cash", 1)],
        "cash_at_beginning": [("SCF", "Cash at start of year", 1)],
        "dividends": [("SOFP", "Dividends paid to shareholders", -1)],
    }

    fields = {}
    for key, parts in spec.items():
        fields[key] = {}
        for yr in ("cy", "py"):
            cells = []
            total = 0
            for sheet, label, f in parts:
                ref = cellref(sheet, label, yr)
                cells.append({"sheet": sheet, "cell": ref, "factor": f})
                total += f * val(sheet, ref)
            fields[key][yr] = {"value": total, "cells": cells}

    # Printed totals: (sheet, label, formula)
    tot_spec = [
        ("IS", "Gross profit", "gross_profit"),
        ("IS", "Total administrative expenses", "administrative_expenses"),
        ("IS", "Profit from operations", "operating_profit"),
        ("IS", "Profit before tax", "profit_before_tax"),
        ("IS", "Net profit", "profit_for_year"),
        ("SOFP", "Total non-current assets", "total_non_current_assets"),
        ("SOFP", "Total current assets", "total_current_assets"),
        ("SOFP", "TOTAL ASSETS", "total_assets"),
        ("SOFP", "Total equity", "total_equity"),
        ("SOFP", "Total non-current liabilities", "total_non_current_liabilities"),
        ("SOFP", "Total current liabilities", "total_current_liabilities"),
        ("SOFP", "Total liabilities", "total_liabilities"),
        ("SOFP", "TOTAL EQUITY AND LIABILITIES", "total_equity_and_liabilities"),
        ("SOFP", "Profit for the year", "profit_for_year"),
        ("SOFP", "Closing retained earnings", "retained_earnings"),
        ("SCF", "Net change in cash and cash equivalents", "net_change_in_cash"),
        ("SCF", "Cash at end of year", "cash_at_end"),
    ]
    source_totals = []
    for sheet, label, formula in tot_spec:
        for yr in ("cy", "py"):
            source_totals.append({
                "sheet": sheet,
                "cell": cellref(sheet, label, yr),
                "year": yr,
                "factor": 1,
                "formula": formula,
            })

    # Opening retained earnings is last year's closing balance, already used from the balance sheet
    ignored = []
    for yr in ("cy", "py"):
        ignored.append({
            "sheet": "SOFP",
            "cell": cellref("SOFP", "Opening retained earnings", yr),
            "reason": "Opening retained earnings in the reconciliation; equals the prior-year closing "
                      "balance already taken from the balance sheet (and not a template input).",
        })

    # Detect printed totals that do not agree with their components
    source_exceptions = []
    for yr in ("cy", "py"):
        comp = sum(fields["administrative_expenses"][yr]["value"] for _ in [0])
        ref = cellref("IS", "Total administrative expenses", yr)
        printed = val("IS", ref)
        if printed != comp:
            source_exceptions.append({
                "check": "T IS!%s %s" % (ref, yr),
                "difference": printed - comp,
                "explanation": (
                    "Printed 'Total administrative expenses' differs from the sum of the three "
                    "administrative lines above it. The component lines are consistent with the printed "
                    "'Profit from operations', so the components were used and the printed subtotal "
                    "left as it is."
                ),
            })

    return {
        "entity_code": "TW-KE01",
        "source_entity_name": str(ws_is["A1"].value),
        "currency": "KES",
        "unit": unit,
        "period_end": period_end,
        "fields": fields,
        "source_totals": source_totals,
        "ignored": ignored,
        "source_exceptions": source_exceptions,
        "notes": (
            "The workbook is for Tarnwell E.A. Ltd, in KShs'000, matched to TW-KE01 (Tarnwell East Africa "
            "Limited, Kenya, KES). Administrative expenses are the sum of the three detail lines; the printed "
            "2025 subtotal is 2,700 higher than those lines, while operating profit ties to the detail, so it is "
            "declared as a source exception. Dividends come from 'Dividends paid to shareholders' in the "
            "retained earnings reconciliation (sign flipped); no separate declared figure is given. "
            "Short-term borrowings and loans due after one year are mapped to the borrowings lines, with no "
            "separate lease liabilities shown. Investments are absent from the workbook and are set to 0. "
            "Other gains and losses (net) is mapped to other operating income (expense), net."
        ),
    }
```

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. ## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)

| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |

| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

## What extract(path) must return: a JSON-serialisable dict with these keys
- "entity_code": the register code of the entity the workbook belongs to.
- "source_entity_name": the entity name as written in the workbook.
- "currency": the ISO code of the amounts (it must match the register).
- "unit": 1, 1000 or 1000000, meaning what one unit of the values you return stands for. Keep the workbook's
  own unit when it is one of these; otherwise convert (for example lakhs to thousands).
- "period_end": {"cy": "YYYY-MM-DD", "py": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, the balance-sheet dates of the two years.
- "fields": for every one of the 33 keys, {"cy": LINE, "py": LINE} with
  LINE = {"value": number, "cells": [{"sheet": sheet name, "cell": "D12", "factor": number}, ...]}.
  value must equal the sum of factor x (the number in each cited cell). factor carries any sign change and unit
  conversion (for example -1, 1 or 100). A line that does not appear in the workbook has value 0 and no cells.
- "source_totals": the totals and subtotals printed in the workbook, so they can be checked. Each is
  {"sheet", "cell", "year": "cy" or "py", "factor", "formula"}, where factor x the printed number must equal the
  formula, an expression over the template keys and totals above using + and - only (for example
  "distribution_costs + administrative_expenses"). For a subtotal that matches no template expression use
  {"sheet", "cell", "year", "factor", "sum_of": [cells as in LINE]} instead of "formula".
- "ignored": numbers in the workbook you deliberately do not use, each {"sheet", "range": "C5:C40" (or "cell": "C5"),
  "reason"} with a specific reason (budget column, another entity, note references, superseded draft, ...).
- "source_exceptions": problems in the workbook itself, each {"check": the check id, "difference": the difference
  the check reports, "explanation": text}. Leave it empty when the workbook is consistent.
- "notes": a few sentences on decisions a reviewer should know about.

## Checks that will run on your output
- every cited cell exists and holds a number, and each line's value equals its cells times their factors;
- revenue, costs, assets, liabilities, share capital and dividends are not negative;
- the statements are not empty;
- every entry in source_totals agrees with the template (check id "T <sheet>!<cell> <year>");
- the balance sheet balances ("R1 balance cy", "R1 balance py"); the cash flow ends at balance-sheet cash
  ("R2 cash_at_end cy", "R2 cash_at_end py"); opening cash equals last year's balance-sheet cash ("R3 opening cash cy");
  retained earnings roll forward, prior + profit - dividends = current ("R4 retained earnings cy");
- coverage: in every column you take amounts from, each number below the first amount you use must be used,
  listed in source_totals or listed in ignored.

## Rules for the code
- Python 3 standard library and openpyxl only. Load with openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True).
- Define extract(path) -> dict. Never write, save, rename or delete any file; no network; no subprocess; no printing.

```python
def _norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(s)).strip()


def _num(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, str):
        t = v.strip()
        for ch in ("'", "’", "\u00a0", " ", ","):
            t = t.replace(ch, "")
        t = t.replace("−", "-")
        neg = t.startswith("(") and t.endswith(")")
        t = t.strip("()")
        try:
            x = float(t)
        except ValueError:
            return None
        x = -x if neg else x
        return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
    return None


def extract(path):
    wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)

    def find_row(ws, label, after=0):
        want = _norm(label)
        for r in range(after + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
            v = ws.cell(r, 2).value
            if v is not None and _norm(v) == want:
                return r
        raise KeyError(label)

    # year header rows and columns
    def header_rows(ws):
        out = []
        for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            cols = []
            for c in range(3, ws.max_column + 1):
                n = _num(ws.cell(r, c).value)
                if isinstance(n, int) and 1990 <= n <= 2100 and ws.cell(r, 2).value is None:
                    cols.append((n, c))
            if len(cols) >= 2:
                out.append((r, sorted(cols, reverse=True)))
        return out

    heads = {n: header_rows(wb[n]) for n in (ER, BS, CF)}
    colmap = {}
    for n in heads:
        cols = heads[n][0][1]
        colmap[n] = {"cy": cols[0][1], "py": cols[1][1]}
    cy_year = heads[BS][0][1][0][0]

    def letter(c):
        return chr(64 + c)

    def ref(sheet, row, yr):
        return f"{letter(colmap[sheet][yr])}{row}"

    def val(sheet, row, yr):
        return _num(wb[sheet].cell(row, colmap[sheet][yr]).value)

    # entity
    name = _norm(wb[BS].cell(1, 2).value)
    code = cur = None
    for legal, (c, k) in sorted(REGISTER.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[0])):
        if _norm(legal).lower() in name.lower():
            code, cur = c, k
            break

    unit_txt = _norm(wb[BS].cell(4, 2).value)
    unit = 1
    if "1'000'000" in unit_txt or "Mio" in unit_txt:
        unit = 1000000
    elif "1'000" in unit_txt or unit_txt.upper().startswith("IN T"):
        unit = 1000

    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})", str(wb[BS].cell(3, 2).value))
    if m:
        d, mo, y = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
    else:
        d, mo, y = 31, 12, cy_year
    period_end = {
        "cy": f"{y:04d}-{mo:02d}-{d:02d}",
        "py": f"{y - 1:04d}-{mo:02d}-{d:02d}",
    }

    # fields
    fields = {}
    for key, items in SPEC.items():
        fields[key] = {}
        for yr in ("cy", "py"):
            cells, total = [], 0
            for sheet, label, factor in items:
                row = find_row(wb[sheet], label)
                cells.append({"sheet": sheet, "cell": ref(sheet, row, yr), "factor": factor})
                total += factor * val(sheet, row, yr)
            fields[key][yr] = {"value": total, "cells": cells}

    # printed totals
    source_totals = []
    for sheet, label, formula in TOTALS:
        row = find_row(wb[sheet], label)
        for yr in ("cy", "py"):
            source_totals.append({
                "sheet": sheet, "cell": ref(sheet, row, yr), "year": yr,
                "factor": 1, "formula": formula,
            })

    # ignored
    ignored = []
    r_open = find_row(wb[BS], "Stand 1. Januar")
    ignored.append({
        "sheet": BS,
        "range": f"{ref(BS, r_open, 'cy')}:{ref(BS, r_open, 'py')}",
        "reason": "Opening retained earnings in the roll-forward; equals the prior-year "
                  "closing balance already taken from the balance sheet line.",
    })
    for r, cols in heads[BS][1:]:
        cs = sorted(c for _, c in cols)
        ignored.append({
            "sheet": BS,
            "range": f"{letter(cs[0])}{r}:{letter(cs[-1])}{r}",
            "reason": "Year column headers of the retained earnings roll-forward table, not amounts.",
        })

    # workbook consistency checks
    def f(key, yr):
        return fields[key][yr]["value"]

    exceptions = []
    for yr in ("cy", "py"):
        assets = (f("property_plant_equipment", yr) + f("right_of_use_assets", yr)
                  + f("intangible_assets", yr) + f("investments", yr)
                  + f("deferred_tax_assets", yr) + f("inventories", yr)
                  + f("trade_receivables", yr) + f("other_current_assets", yr)
                  + f("cash_and_cash_equivalents", yr))
        eq_liab = (f("share_capital", yr) + f("retained_earnings", yr) + f("other_reserves", yr)
                   + f("trade_payables", yr) + f("other_current_liabilities", yr)
                   + f("current_borrowings", yr) + f("current_tax_payable", yr)
                   + f("non_current_borrowings", yr) + f("provisions", yr)
                   + f("deferred_tax_liabilities", yr))
        if assets != eq_liab:
            exceptions.append({
                "check": f"R1 balance {yr}", "difference": assets - eq_liab,
                "explanation": "Total assets differ from total equity and liabilities in the workbook.",
            })
        end = (f("cash_at_beginning", yr) + f("net_cash_operating", yr)
               + f("net_cash_investing", yr) + f("net_cash_financing", yr)
               + f("fx_effect_on_cash", yr))
        diff = end - f("cash_and_cash_equivalents", yr)
        if diff != 0:
            exceptions.append({
                "check": f"R2 cash_at_end {yr}", "difference": diff,
                "explanation": "The cash flow statement ends at a different amount than the cash "
                               "line on the balance sheet (cash flow end minus balance sheet cash). "
                               "Both are kept exactly as printed; the cash flow statement itself "
                               "adds up and its printed end-of-period figure matches its components.",
            })

    notes = (
        "Figures are in TCHF (unit 1000) and kept as printed; text values with apostrophe thousand "
        "separators are parsed in code. Expenses and tax are printed negative in the source and are "
        "cited with factor -1; the tax line is a charge (profit before tax less profit for the year). "
        "Finance income combines interest on loans to group companies and other interest income. "
        "Steuerrückstellungen are mapped to current income tax payable. The entity is a treasury "
        "centre with no cost of sales. Dividends come from the retained earnings roll-forward "
        "(Ausschüttung an die Gesellschafter). The cash flow statement ends in 2025 at a figure that "
        "differs from balance sheet cash; this is declared as a source exception and not adjusted."
    )

    return {
        "entity_code": code,
        "source_entity_name": name,
        "currency": cur,
        "unit": unit,
        "period_end": period_end,
        "fields": fields,
        "source_totals": source_totals,
        "ignored": ignored,
        "source_exceptions": exceptions,
        "notes": notes,
    }
```

```python
import calendar
import math
import re
from datetime import datetime
from numbers import Real

import openpyxl


FIELD_KEYS = (
    "revenue", "cost_of_sales", "distribution_costs",
    "administrative_expenses", "other_operating_income",
    "finance_income", "finance_costs", "income_tax_expense",
    "property_plant_equipment", "right_of_use_assets", "intangible_assets",
    "investments", "deferred_tax_assets", "inventories", "trade_receivables",
    "other_current_assets", "cash_and_cash_equivalents", "trade_payables",
    "other_current_liabilities", "current_borrowings", "current_tax_payable",
    "non_current_borrowings", "provisions", "deferred_tax_liabilities",
    "share_capital", "retained_earnings", "other_reserves",
    "net_cash_operating", "net_cash_investing", "net_cash_financing",
    "fx_effect_on_cash", "cash_at_beginning", "dividends",
)

TOTAL_FORMULAS = {
    "gross_profit": "revenue - cost_of_sales",
    "operating_profit":
        "gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses"
        " + other_operating_income",
    "profit_before_tax": "operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs",
    "profit_for_year": "profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense",
    "total_non_current_assets":
        "property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets"
        " + investments + deferred_tax_assets",
    "total_current_assets":
        "inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets"
        " + cash_and_cash_equivalents",
    "total_assets": "total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets",
    "total_current_liabilities":
        "trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings"
        " + current_tax_payable",
    "total_non_current_liabilities":
        "non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities",
    "total_liabilities":
        "total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities",
    "total_equity": "share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves",
    "total_equity_and_liabilities": "total_equity + total_liabilities",
    "net_change_in_cash":
        "net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing",
    "cash_at_end": "cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash",
}


def _normalise(value):
    return " ".join(str(value or "").strip().casefold().split())


def _is_number(value):
    return (
        isinstance(value, Real)
        and not isinstance(value, bool)
        and math.isfinite(value)
    )


def _expression_value(expression, values):
    """Evaluate the adapter's internal expressions without using eval()."""
    tokens = expression.split()
    if not tokens or len(tokens) % 2 != 1:
        raise ValueError("Invalid reconciliation expression")
    result = values[tokens[0]]
    for index in range(1, len(tokens), 2):
        operator, name = tokens[index:index + 2]
        if operator == "+":
            result += values[name]
        elif operator == "-":
            result -= values[name]
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported reconciliation operator")
    return result


def extract(path):
    workbook = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
    try:
        sheet_names = ("P&L", "BS", "CF", "Reserves")
        for name in sheet_names:
            if name not in workbook.sheetnames:
                raise ValueError(f"Required sheet missing: {name}")

        sheets = {name: workbook[name] for name in sheet_names}
        source_name = sheets["BS"]["B1"].value
        aliases = {
            "tarnwell engineering ltd",
            "tarnwell engineering ltd.",
            "tarnwell engineering limited",
        }
        if _normalise(source_name) not in aliases:
            raise ValueError("Workbook does not identify TW-UK02 unambiguously")
        for sheet in sheets.values():
            if _normalise(sheet["B1"].value) not in aliases:
                raise ValueError(f"Inconsistent entity name on {sheet.title}")

        date_match = re.search(
            r"\b(\d{1,2}\s+[A-Za-z]+\s+\d{4})\b",
            str(sheets["BS"]["B2"].value),
        )
        if not date_match:
            raise ValueError("Cannot identify the balance-sheet date")
        closing_date = datetime.strptime(
            date_match.group(1), "%d %B %Y"
        ).date()

        columns = {}
        header_rows = {}
        for name, sheet in sheets.items():
            headers = []
            for row in sheet.iter_rows():
                if any(_normalise(cell.value) == "note" for cell in row):
                    headers.append(row)
            if len(headers) != 1:
                raise ValueError(f"Cannot identify unique year header on {name}")

            header = headers[0]
            header_rows[name] = header[0].row
            year_columns = {}
            for cell in header:
                text = str(cell.value).strip()
                if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}", text):
                    year = int(text)
                    if year in year_columns:
                        raise ValueError(f"Duplicate year column on {name}")
                    year_columns[year] = cell.column

            cy_year = closing_date.year
            if set(year_columns) != {cy_year, cy_year - 1}:
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected reporting years on {name}")
            columns[name] = {
                "cy": year_columns[cy_year],
                "py": year_columns[cy_year - 1],
            }

            for column in columns[name].values():
                unit_text = str(
                    sheet.cell(header_rows[name] + 1, column).value
                ).strip()
                if unit_text != "£'000":
                    raise ValueError(f"Unexpected currency or unit on {name}")

        prior_day = min(
            closing_date.day,
            calendar.monthrange(closing_date.year - 1, closing_date.month)[1],
        )
        prior_date = closing_date.replace(
            year=closing_date.year - 1, day=prior_day
        )

        result = {
            "entity_code": "TW-UK02",
            "source_entity_name": source_name,
            "currency": "GBP",
            "unit": 1000,
            "period_end": {
                "cy": closing_date.isoformat(),
                "py": prior_date.isoformat(),
            },
            "fields": {
                key: {
                    year: {"value": 0, "cells": []}
                    for year in ("cy", "py")
                }
                for key in FIELD_KEYS
            },
            "source_totals": [],
            "ignored": [],
            "source_exceptions": [],
            "notes": (
                "The workbook's abbreviated entity name identifies Tarnwell "
                "Engineering Limited (TW-UK02). Amounts remain in GBP thousands. "
                "Source expenses and dividends are reversed from negative "
                "presentation; other operating income retains its signed value. "
                "The deferred tax asset is reclassified from local debtors to "
                "non-current assets; local subtotals retain their original scope. "
                "Overdrafts are current borrowings, while cash follows the "
                "workbook's cash-flow definition. Dividends paid are used as "
                "the year's dividends because they are the distribution shown "
                "in the retained earnings movement. Unpresented input lines "
                "are zero."
            ),
        }

        accounted = {name: set() for name in sheet_names}

        def find_row(sheet_name, label, section=None):
            sheet = sheets[sheet_name]
            start, stop = 1, sheet.max_row + 1
            if section is not None:
                start = find_row(sheet_name, section) + 1
                # The repeated bank-loan label is bounded by its next section.
                next_sections = {
                    "Creditors: amounts falling due within one year":
                        "Total creditors due within one year",
                    "Creditors: amounts falling due after more than one year":
                        "Provisions for liabilities",
                }
                stop = find_row(sheet_name, next_sections[section])
            matches = [
                row for row in range(start, stop)
                if _normalise(sheet.cell(row, 2).value) == _normalise(label)
            ]
            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expected one row for {sheet_name}: {label!r}"
                )
            return matches[0]

        def reference(sheet_name, label, year, factor=1, section=None):
            row = find_row(sheet_name, label, section)
            cell = sheets[sheet_name].cell(row, columns[sheet_name][year])
            if not _is_number(cell.value):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expected numeric amount at {sheet_name}!{cell.coordinate}"
                )
            accounted[sheet_name].add(cell.coordinate)
            return {
                "sheet": sheet_name,
                "cell": cell.coordinate,
                "factor": factor,
            }

        def amount(ref):
            return ref["factor"] * sheets[ref["sheet"]][ref["cell"]].value

        def add_field(key, sheet_name, label, factor=1, section=None):
            for year in ("cy", "py"):
                ref = reference(sheet_name, label, year, factor, section)
                line = result["fields"][key][year]
                line["cells"].append(ref)
                line["value"] += amount(ref)

        mappings = (
            ("revenue", "P&L", "Turnover", 1),
            ("cost_of_sales", "P&L", "Cost of sales", -1),
            ("distribution_costs", "P&L", "Distribution costs", -1),
            ("administrative_expenses", "P&L", "Administrative expenses", -1),
            ("other_operating_income", "P&L", "Other operating income", 1),
            ("finance_income", "P&L",
             "Interest receivable and similar income", 1),
            ("finance_costs", "P&L",
             "Interest payable and similar expenses", -1),
            ("income_tax_expense", "P&L", "Tax on profit", -1),
            ("property_plant_equipment", "BS", "Tangible assets", 1),
            ("intangible_assets", "BS", "Intangible assets", 1),
            ("deferred_tax_assets", "BS", "Deferred tax asset", 1),
            ("inventories", "BS", "Stocks", 1),
            ("trade_receivables", "BS", "Trade debtors", 1),
            ("other_current_assets", "BS", "Prepayments and accrued income", 1),
            ("other_current_assets", "BS", "Other debtors", 1),
            ("cash_and_cash_equivalents", "BS", "Cash at bank and in hand", 1),
            ("trade_payables", "BS", "Trade creditors", 1),
            ("other_current_liabilities", "BS",
             "Accruals and deferred income", 1),
            ("other_current_liabilities", "BS",
             "Other taxation and social security", 1),
            ("current_borrowings", "BS", "Bank overdraft", 1),
            ("current_tax_payable", "BS", "Corporation tax", 1),
            ("provisions", "BS", "Other provisions", 1),
            ("deferred_tax_liabilities", "BS", "Deferred taxation", 1),
            ("share_capital", "BS", "Called up share capital", 1),
            ("share_capital", "BS", "Share premium account", 1),
            ("retained_earnings", "BS", "Profit and loss account", 1),
            ("other_reserves", "BS", "Other reserves", 1),
            ("net_cash_operating", "CF",
             "Net cash from operating activities", 1),
            ("net_cash_investing", "CF",
             "Net cash from investing activities", 1),
            ("net_cash_financing", "CF",
             "Net cash from financing activities", 1),
            ("fx_effect_on_cash", "CF",
             "Effect of foreign exchange rate changes", 1),
            ("cash_at_beginning", "CF", "Cash at beginning of year", 1),
            ("dividends", "Reserves", "Dividends paid on equity shares", -1),
        )
        for mapping in mappings:
            add_field(*mapping)

        add_field(
            "current_borrowings", "BS", "Bank loans",
            section="Creditors: amounts falling due within one year",
        )
        add_field(
            "non_current_borrowings", "BS", "Bank loans",
            section="Creditors: amounts falling due after more than one year",
        )

        def add_total(sheet_name, label, formula):
            for year in ("cy", "py"):
                ref = reference(sheet_name, label, year)
                result["source_totals"].append({
                    **ref, "year": year, "formula": formula,
                })

        totals = (
            ("P&L", "Gross profit", "gross_profit"),
            ("P&L", "Operating profit", "operating_profit"),
            ("P&L", "Profit before taxation", "profit_before_tax"),
            ("P&L", "Profit for the financial year", "profit_for_year"),
            ("BS", "Total fixed assets",
             "property_plant_equipment + intangible_assets"),
            ("BS", "Total debtors",
             "trade_receivables + other_current_assets + deferred_tax_assets"),
            ("BS", "Total current assets",
             "total_current_assets + deferred_tax_assets"),
            ("BS", "Total creditors due within one year",
             "total_current_liabilities"),
            ("BS", "Net current assets",
             "total_current_assets + deferred_tax_assets"
             " - total_current_liabilities"),
            ("BS", "Total assets less current liabilities",
             "total_assets - total_current_liabilities"),
            ("BS", "Net assets", "total_assets - total_liabilities"),
            ("BS", "Shareholders' funds", "total_equity"),
            ("CF", "Net increase/(decrease) in cash", "net_change_in_cash"),
            ("CF", "Cash at end of year", "cash_at_end"),
            ("Reserves", "At beginning of year",
             "retained_earnings - profit_for_year + dividends"),
            ("Reserves", "Profit for the financial year", "profit_for_year"),
            ("Reserves", "At end of year", "retained_earnings"),
        )
        for total in totals:
            add_total(*total)

        # Note references are deliberately excluded from financial amounts.
        for name, sheet in sheets.items():
            for row in sheet.iter_rows():
                for cell in row:
                    if cell.column == 3 and _is_number(cell.value):
                        result["ignored"].append({
                            "sheet": name,
                            "cell": cell.coordinate,
                            "reason": "Financial statement note reference.",
                        })

        # Reject unexpected amounts rather than silently discard new content.
        for name, sheet in sheets.items():
            for column in columns[name].values():
                used_rows = [
                    sheet[coordinate].row
                    for coordinate in accounted[name]
                    if sheet[coordinate].column == column
                ]
                first_used = min(used_rows)
                for row in range(first_used, sheet.max_row + 1):
                    cell = sheet.cell(row, column)
                    if (
                        _is_number(cell.value)
                        and cell.coordinate not in accounted[name]
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unmapped numeric amount: {name}!{cell.coordinate}"
                        )

        values = {}
        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            values[year] = {
                key: result["fields"][key][year]["value"]
                for key in FIELD_KEYS
            }
            for key, expression in TOTAL_FORMULAS.items():
                values[year][key] = _expression_value(
                    expression, values[year]
                )

        def check(check_id, actual, expected, explanation):
            difference = actual - expected
            if not math.isclose(difference, 0, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-8):
                result["source_exceptions"].append({
                    "check": check_id,
                    "difference": difference,
                    "explanation": explanation,
                })

        for total in result["source_totals"]:
            check(
                f"T {total['sheet']}!{total['cell']} {total['year']}",
                amount(total),
                _expression_value(total["formula"], values[total["year"]]),
                "The printed source amount minus its mapped expression "
                "is nonzero; all source amounts have been preserved.",
            )

        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            v = values[year]
            check(
                f"R1 balance {year}",
                v["total_assets"],
                v["total_equity_and_liabilities"],
                "Source assets minus equity and liabilities is nonzero.",
            )
            check(
                f"R2 cash_at_end {year}",
                v["cash_at_end"],
                v["cash_and_cash_equivalents"],
                "Calculated cash-flow closing cash minus balance-sheet "
                "cash is nonzero.",
            )

        check(
            "R3 opening cash cy",
            values["cy"]["cash_at_beginning"],
            values["py"]["cash_and_cash_equivalents"],
            "Current-year opening cash minus prior-year balance-sheet "
            "cash is nonzero.",
        )
        check(
            "R4 retained earnings cy",
            values["cy"]["retained_earnings"],
            values["py"]["retained_earnings"]
            + values["cy"]["profit_for_year"]
            - values["cy"]["dividends"],
            "Closing retained earnings minus prior retained earnings "
            "plus current profit less dividends is nonzero.",
        )

        return result
    finally:
        workbook.close()
```

You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves

```python
    if isinstance(v, str):
```
