- every cited cell exists and holds a number, and each line's value equals its cells times their factors;
- revenue, costs, assets, liabilities, share capital and dividends are not negative;
- the statements are not empty;
- every entry in source_totals agrees with the template (check id "T <sheet>!<cell> <year>");
- the balance sheet balances ("R1 balance cy", "R1 balance py"); the cash flow ends at balance-sheet cash
  ("R2 cash_at_end cy", "R2 cash_at_end py"); opening cash equals last year's balance-sheet cash ("R3 opening cash cy");
  retained earnings roll forward, prior + profit - dividends = current ("R4 retained earnings cy");
- coverage: in every column you take amounts from, each number below the first amount you use must be used,
  listed in source_totals or listed in ignored.

request.prompt:
You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |
| cash_at_beginning | CF / Cash flows | Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of year | Opening cash. |
| dividends | EQ / Retained earnings | Dividends declared | Dividends declared to shareholders in the year, as a positive number. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

- "entity_code": the register code of the entity the workbook belongs to.
- "source_entity_name": the entity name as written in the workbook.
- "currency": the ISO code of the amounts (it must match the register).
- "unit": 1, 1000 or 1000000, meaning what one unit of the values you return stands for. Keep the workbook's

- "period_end": {"cy": "YYYY-MM-DD", "py": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, the balance-sheet dates of the two years.
- "fields": for every one of the 33 keys, {"cy": LINE, "py": LINE} with
  LINE = {"value": number, "cells": [{"sheet": sheet name, "cell": "D12", "factor": number}, ...]}.
  value must equal the sum of factor x (the number in each cited cell). factor carries any sign change and unit
  conversion (for example -1, 1 or 100). A line that does not appear in the workbook has value 0 and no cells.
- "source_totals": the totals and subtotals printed in the workbook, so they can be checked. Each is
  {"sheet", "cell", "year": "cy" or "py", "factor", "formula"}, where factor x the printed number must equal the
  formula, an expression over the template keys and totals above using + and - only (for example
  "distribution_costs + administrative_expenses"). For a subtotal that matches no template expression use
  {"sheet", "cell", "year", "factor", "sum_of": [cells as in LINE]} instead of "formula".
- "ignored": numbers in the workbook you deliberately do not use, each {"sheet", "range": "C5:C40" (or "cell": "C5"),
  "reason"} with a specific reason (budget column, another entity, note references, superseded draft, ...).
- "source_exceptions": problems in the workbook itself, each {"check": the check id, "difference": the difference
  the check reports, "explanation": text}. Leave it empty when the workbook is consistent.
- "notes": a few sentences on decisions a reviewer should know about.

- every cited cell exists and holds a number, and each line's value equals its cells times their factors;
- revenue, costs, assets, liabilities, share capital and dividends are not negative;
- the statements are not empty;
- every entry in source_totals agrees with the template (check id "T <sheet>!<cell> <year>");
- the balance sheet balances ("R1 balance cy", "R1 balance py"); the cash flow ends at balance-sheet cash
  ("R2 cash_at_end cy", "R2 cash_at_end py"); opening cash equals last year's balance-sheet cash ("R3 opening cash cy");
  retained earnings roll forward, prior + profit - dividends = current ("R4 retained earnings cy");
- coverage: in every column you take amounts from, each number below the first amount you use must be used,
  listed in source_totals or listed in ignored.

## Rules for the code
- Python 3 standard library and openpyxl only. Load with openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True).
- Define extract(path) -> dict. Never write, save, rename or delete any file; no network; no subprocess; no printing.
- Read every amount from the cells in code. Do not type amounts from the workbook into the code.
- Find rows by their labels rather than fixed row numbers where you can, so the adapter survives a moved row.
- If the workbook itself is inconsistent (a printed total does not add up, or the statements do not tie), keep the
  workbook's numbers exactly as they are and declare a source_exception for that check. Never change, plug or force

```python
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter


def _norm(s):
    return " ".join(str(s).split()).lower()


def extract(path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)

    def label_rows(ws):
        out = {}
        for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            v = ws.cell(r, 1).value
            if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
                out.setdefault(_norm(v), r)
        return out

    def year_cols(ws):
        # find the header row holding the two year strings, e.g. "2025" / "2024"
        for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            found = {}
            for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
                v = ws.cell(r, c).value
                if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
                    v = str(int(v))
                if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip().isdigit() and len(v.strip()) == 4:
                    found[int(v.strip())] = c
            if len(found) >= 2:
                ys = sorted(found, reverse=True)
                return ys[0], ys[1], get_column_letter(found[ys[0]]), get_column_letter(found[ys[1]])
        raise ValueError("year header not found")

    sheets = {}
    for name in wb.sheetnames:
        ws = wb[name]
        sheets[name] = {"ws": ws, "rows": label_rows(ws), "cols": year_cols(ws)}

    cy_year, py_year, _, _ = sheets["ER"]["cols"]

    def cell_ref(sheet, label, year):
        s = sheets[sheet]
        r = s["rows"][_norm(label)]
        col = s["cols"][2] if year == "cy" else s["cols"][3]
        return col + str(r)

    def num(sheet, ref):
        v = sheets[sheet]["ws"][ref].value
        if not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or isinstance(v, bool):
            raise ValueError(f"{sheet}!{ref} is not numeric")
        return v

    def line(items, year):
        cells = []
        total = 0
        for sheet, label, factor in items:
            ref = cell_ref(sheet, label, year)
            cells.append({"sheet": sheet, "cell": ref, "factor": factor})
            total += factor * num(sheet, ref)
        return {"value": total, "cells": cells}

        "other_current_assets": [("ESF", "Otras cuentas por cobrar y pagos anticipados", 1)],
        "cash_and_cash_equivalents": [("ESF", "Efectivo y equivalentes de efectivo", 1)],
        "trade_payables": [("ESF", "Proveedores", 1)],
        "other_current_liabilities": [
            ("ESF", "Otras cuentas por pagar y pasivos acumulados", 1),
            ("ESF", "Participación de los trabajadores en las utilidades (PTU) por pagar", 1)],
        "current_borrowings": [("ESF", "Préstamos bancarios a corto plazo", 1)],
        "current_tax_payable": [("ESF", "Impuestos a la utilidad por pagar", 1)],
        "non_current_borrowings": [("ESF", "Préstamos bancarios a largo plazo", 1)],
        "provisions": [("ESF", "Beneficios a los empleados", 1)],
        "deferred_tax_liabilities": [("ESF", "Impuestos diferidos pasivos", 1)],
        "share_capital": [("ESF", "Capital social", 1)],
        "retained_earnings": [("ESF", "Utilidades retenidas", 1)],
        "other_reserves": [("ESF", "Otras partidas del capital", 1)],

        "net_cash_investing": [("EFE", "Flujos netos de efectivo de actividades de inversión", 1)],
        "net_cash_financing": [("EFE", "Flujos netos de efectivo de actividades de financiamiento", 1)],
        "fx_effect_on_cash": [("EFE", "Efectos por cambios en el valor del efectivo", 1)],

    ignored = []
    # note-reference columns
    for sheet in ("ER", "ESF", "EFE"):
        ws = sheets[sheet]["ws"]
        rows = [r for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1)
                if isinstance(ws.cell(r, 2).value, (int, float))
                and not isinstance(ws.cell(r, 2).value, bool)]
        if rows:
            if len(rows) == 1:
                ignored.append({"sheet": sheet, "cell": f"B{rows[0]}",

            else:
                ignored.append({"sheet": sheet, "range": f"B{rows[0]}:B{rows[-1]}",
```

You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

```python
import re

def _norm(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(s)).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip().lower()


def _num(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool) or v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return v
    s = str(v).strip()
    neg = s.startswith("(") and s.endswith(")")
    s = s.strip("()").replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
    try:
        x = float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    x = -x if neg else x
    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x


def _date(v):
    if isinstance(v, (datetime.datetime, datetime.date)):
        return v.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    m = re.match(r"\s*(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})/(\d{4})", str(v))
    return f"{m.group(3)}-{int(m.group(2)):02d}-{int(m.group(1)):02d}"

        ("cash_at_beginning", [("CF", None, "Caixa no início do exercício", 1)]),
        ("dividends", [("CF", None, "Dividendos declarados", -1)]),
    ]

    fields = {}
    for key, parts in spec:

        for year in ("cy", "py"):

                v = val(re.match(r"[A-Z]+", c).group(), int(re.search(r"\d+", c).group()))
                total += f * v
                cells.append({"sheet": SHEET, "cell": c, "factor": f})
            fields[key][year] = {"value": total, "cells": cells}

    # Printed totals
    totals = []

    def st(block, sec, label, formula, factor=1, years=("cy", "py")):
        for y in years:
            totals.append({"sheet": SHEET, "cell": ref(block, sec, label, y), "year": y,

    st("IS", None, "Lucro líquido do exercício", "profit_for_year")
    st("BS", "ac", "Total do ativo circulante", "total_current_assets")
    st("BS", "anc", "Total do ativo não circulante", "total_non_current_assets")
    st("BS", "anc", "Total do ativo", "total_assets")
    st("BS", "pc", "Total do passivo circulante", "total_current_liabilities")
    st("BS", "pnc", "Total do passivo não circulante", "total_non_current_liabilities")
    st("BS", "pnc", "Total liabilities", "total_liabilities")
    st("BS", "pl", "Total do patrimônio líquido", "total_equity")
    st("BS", "pl", "Total do passivo e patrimônio líquido", "total_equity_and_liabilities")
    st("CF", None, "Aumento (redução) de caixa", "net_change_in_cash")
    st("CF", None, "Caixa no fim do exercício", "cash_at_end")
    # Retained-earnings roll-forward block (cash-flow side of the sheet)
    totals.append({"sheet": SHEET, "cell": ref("CF", None, "Saldo inicial", "cy"), "year": "py",
                   "factor": 1, "formula": "retained_earnings"})
    st("CF", None, "Saldo final", "retained_earnings")
    # Net profit repeated in the roll-forward (second "Lucro líquido do exercício" is in column I)
    ni_row = CF[(None, _norm("Lucro líquido do exercício"))]
    for y, col in (("cy", "J"), ("py", "K")):
        totals.append({"sheet": SHEET, "cell": f"{col}{ni_row}", "year": y,
                       "factor": 1, "formula": "profit_for_year"})

    # The prior-year opening balance of profit reserves has no balance sheet to compare with
    ignored = [{
        "sheet": SHEET,
        "cell": ref("CF", None, "Saldo inicial", "py"),
        "reason": "Opening profit reserves at 1 Jan 2024 (start of prior year); no balance sheet "
                  "for that date in the template, so it is not a template line.",

    # Header data

    period_end = {"cy": _date(ws[f"F{hdr_row}"].value), "py": _date(ws[f"G{hdr_row}"].value)}

    return {
        "entity_code": "TW-BR01",
        "source_entity_name": name,

        "fields": fields,

        "notes": (

            "section. Profit reserves map to retained earnings and the equity valuation adjustments to "
            "other reserves. The roll-forward block under the cash flow ties to retained earnings and "
            "profit and is used as source totals. The workbook is internally consistent."
        ),
    }
```

You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.

the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |

| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |

| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):

- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income

- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets

request.prompt:
You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |
| cash_at_beginning | CF / Cash flows | Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of year | Opening cash. |
| dividends | EQ / Retained earnings | Dividends declared | Dividends declared to shareholders in the year, as a positive number. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

## What extract(path) must return: a JSON-serialisable dict with these keys
- "entity_code": the register code of the entity the workbook belongs to.
- "source_entity_name": the entity name as written in the workbook.
- "currency": the ISO code of the amounts (it must match the register).
- "unit": 1, 1000 or 1000000, meaning what one unit of the values you return stands for. Keep the workbook's
  own unit when it is one of these; otherwise convert (for example lakhs to thousands).
- "period_end": {"cy": "YYYY-MM-DD", "py": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, the balance-sheet dates of the two years.
- "fields": for every one of the 33 keys, {"cy": LINE, "py": LINE} with
  LINE = {"value": number, "cells": [{"sheet": sheet name, "cell": "D12", "factor": number}, ...]}.
  value must equal the sum of factor x (the number in each cited cell). factor carries any sign change and unit
  conversion (for example -1, 1 or 100). A line that does not appear in the workbook has value 0 and no cells.
- "source_totals": the totals and subtotals printed in the workbook, so they can be checked. Each is
  {"sheet", "cell", "year": "cy" or "py", "factor", "formula"}, where factor x the printed number must equal the
  formula, an expression over the template keys and totals above using + and - only (for example
  "distribution_costs + administrative_expenses"). For a subtotal that matches no template expression use
  {"sheet", "cell", "year", "factor", "sum_of": [cells as in LINE]} instead of "formula".
- "ignored": numbers in the workbook you deliberately do not use, each {"sheet", "range": "C5:C40" (or "cell": "C5"),
  "reason"} with a specific reason (budget column, another entity, note references, superseded draft, ...).
- "source_exceptions": problems in the workbook itself, each {"check": the check id, "difference": the difference
  the check reports, "explanation": text}. Leave it empty when the workbook is consistent.
- "notes": a few sentences on decisions a reviewer should know about.

## Checks that will run on your output
- every cited cell exists and holds a number, and each line's value equals its cells times their factors;
- revenue, costs, assets, liabilities, share capital and dividends are not negative;
- the statements are not empty;
- every entry in source_totals agrees with the template (check id "T <sheet>!<cell> <year>");
- the balance sheet balances ("R1 balance cy", "R1 balance py"); the cash flow ends at balance-sheet cash
  ("R2 cash_at_end cy", "R2 cash_at_end py"); opening cash equals last year's balance-sheet cash ("R3 opening cash cy");
  retained earnings roll forward, prior + profit - dividends = current ("R4 retained earnings cy");
- coverage: in every column you take amounts from, each number below the first amount you use must be used,
  listed in source_totals or listed in ignored.

## Rules for the code
- Python 3 standard library and openpyxl only. Load with openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True).
- Define extract(path) -> dict. Never write, save, rename or delete any file; no network; no subprocess; no printing.
- Read every amount from the cells in code. Do not type amounts from the workbook into the code.
- Find rows by their labels rather than fixed row numbers where you can, so the adapter survives a moved row.
- If the workbook itself is inconsistent (a printed total does not add up, or the statements do not tie), keep the
  workbook's numbers exactly as they are and declare a source_exception for that check. Never change, plug or force
  a number to make a check pass.

```python
import re
import openpyxl


FIELD_KEYS = [
    "revenue", "cost_of_sales", "distribution_costs", "administrative_expenses",
    "other_operating_income", "finance_income", "finance_costs", "income_tax_expense",
    "property_plant_equipment", "right_of_use_assets", "intangible_assets", "investments",
    "deferred_tax_assets", "inventories", "trade_receivables", "other_current_assets",
    "cash_and_cash_equivalents", "trade_payables", "other_current_liabilities",
    "current_borrowings", "current_tax_payable", "non_current_borrowings", "provisions",
    "deferred_tax_liabilities", "share_capital", "retained_earnings", "other_reserves",
    "net_cash_operating", "net_cash_investing", "net_cash_financing", "fx_effect_on_cash",
    "cash_at_beginning", "dividends",
]


def _eng(label):
    """English part of a bilingual label (from the first ASCII letter on)."""
    if not isinstance(label, str):
        return None
    m = re.search(r"[A-Za-z].*$", label.strip())
    return m.group(0).strip().lower() if m else None


def _find_row(ws, eng, after=None, before=None):
    target = eng.lower()
    lo = 0
    hi = ws.max_row + 1
    if after:
        lo = _find_row(ws, after)
    if before:
        hi = _find_row(ws, before, after=after)
    for r in range(lo + 1, hi):
        if _eng(ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value) == target:
            return r
    raise KeyError("%s: label %r not found" % (ws.title, eng))


def _year_cols(ws):
    cols = {}
    for r in range(1, 12):
        for c in range(2, ws.max_column + 1):
            v = ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value
            if isinstance(v, str):
                if "前期" in v:
                    cols["py"] = c
                elif "当期" in v:
                    cols["cy"] = c
        if len(cols) == 2:
            return cols
    raise KeyError("%s: year columns not found" % ws.title)


def _col_letter(c):
    return openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(c)


def _unit(ws):
    for r in range(1, 8):
        v = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
        if isinstance(v, str) and "単位" in v:
            if "百万円" in v:
                return 1000000
            if "千円" in v:
                return 1000
            return 1
    return 1000000


def extract(path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
    names = wb.sheetnames

    def sheet(name, idx):
        return wb[name] if name in names else wb.worksheets[idx]

    IS = sheet("損益計算書", 0)
    BS = sheet("貸借対照表", 1)
    CF = sheet("CF計算書", 2)
    EQ = sheet("株主資本等変動", 3)
    colmap = {ws.title: _year_cols(ws) for ws in (IS, BS, CF, EQ)}

    def ref(ws, eng, year, factor=1, after=None, before=None):
        r = _find_row(ws, eng, after, before)
        c = colmap[ws.title][year]
        return {"sheet": ws.title, "cell": "%s%d" % (_col_letter(c), r), "factor": factor}

    def value_of(cells):
        total = 0
        for ce in cells:
            ws = wb[ce["sheet"]]
            total += ce["factor"] * ws[ce["cell"]].value
        return total

    CA = dict(after="Current assets", before="Total current assets")
    CL = dict(after="Current liabilities", before="Total current liabilities")

    # key -> list of (sheet, english label, factor, bounds)
    spec = {
        "revenue": [(IS, "Net sales", 1, {})],
        "cost_of_sales": [(IS, "Cost of sales", 1, {})],
        "distribution_costs": [(IS, "Selling expenses", 1, {})],
        "administrative_expenses": [(IS, "General and administrative", 1, {})],
        "other_operating_income": [(IS, "Miscellaneous income", 1, {})],
        "finance_income": [(IS, "Interest income", 1, {})],
        "finance_costs": [(IS, "Interest expense", 1, {})],
        "income_tax_expense": [(IS, "Current income taxes", 1, {}),
                               (IS, "Deferred income taxes", 1, {})],
        "property_plant_equipment": [(BS, "Property and equipment", 1, {})],
        "right_of_use_assets": [(BS, "Right-of-use assets", 1, {})],
        "intangible_assets": [(BS, "Intangible assets", 1, {})],
        "investments": [],
        "deferred_tax_assets": [(BS, "Deferred tax assets", 1, {})],
        "inventories": [(BS, "Inventories", 1, {})],
        "trade_receivables": [(BS, "Accounts receivable", 1, {})],
        "other_current_assets": [(BS, "Other", 1, CA)],
        "cash_and_cash_equivalents": [(BS, "Cash and deposits", 1, {})],
        "trade_payables": [(BS, "Accounts payable", 1, {})],
        "other_current_liabilities": [(BS, "Other", 1, CL)],
        "current_borrowings": [(BS, "Short-term loans", 1, {})],
        "current_tax_payable": [(BS, "Income taxes payable", 1, {})],
        "non_current_borrowings": [(BS, "Long-term loans", 1, {})],
        "provisions": [(BS, "Retirement benefit liability", 1, {})],
        "deferred_tax_liabilities": [(BS, "Deferred tax liabilities", 1, {})],
        "share_capital": [(BS, "Capital stock", 1, {}),
                          (BS, "Capital surplus", 1, {})],
        "retained_earnings": [(BS, "Retained earnings", 1, {})],
        "other_reserves": [(BS, "Accumulated other comprehensive income", 1, {})],
        "net_cash_operating": [(CF, "Operating activities", 1, {})],
        "net_cash_investing": [(CF, "Investing activities", 1, {})],
        "net_cash_financing": [(CF, "Financing activities", 1, {})],
        "fx_effect_on_cash": [(CF, "FX effect", 1, {})],
        "cash_at_beginning": [(CF, "Beginning balance", 1, {})],
        "dividends": [(EQ, "Dividends", -1, {})],
    }

    fields = {}
    for key in FIELD_KEYS:
        fields[key] = {}
        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            cells = [ref(ws, eng, year, f, **b) for ws, eng, f, b in spec[key]]
            fields[key][year] = {"value": value_of(cells), "cells": cells}

    # Printed totals and subtotals
    totals_spec = [
        (IS, "Gross profit", {}, "gross_profit"),
        (IS, "Total SG&A", {}, "distribution_costs + administrative_expenses"),
        (IS, "Operating income", {}, "gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses"),
        (IS, "Total non-operating income", {}, "finance_income + other_operating_income"),
        (IS, "Ordinary income", {}, "profit_before_tax"),
        (IS, "Income before income taxes", {}, "profit_before_tax"),
        (IS, "Net income", {}, "profit_for_year"),
        (BS, "Total current assets", {}, "total_current_assets"),
        (BS, "Total non-current assets", {}, "total_non_current_assets"),
        (BS, "Total assets", {}, "total_assets"),
        (BS, "Total current liabilities", {}, "total_current_liabilities"),
        (BS, "Total liabilities", {}, "total_liabilities"),
        (BS, "Total net assets", {}, "total_equity"),
        (BS, "Total liabilities and net assets", {}, "total_equity_and_liabilities"),
        (CF, "Net change", {}, "net_change_in_cash"),
        (CF, "Ending balance", {}, "cash_at_end"),
        (EQ, "Net income", {}, "profit_for_year"),
        (EQ, "Ending balance", {}, "retained_earnings"),
    ]
    source_totals = []
    for ws, eng, bounds, formula in totals_spec:
        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            ce = ref(ws, eng, year, 1, **bounds)
            source_totals.append({
                "sheet": ce["sheet"], "cell": ce["cell"], "year": year,
                "factor": 1, "formula": formula,
            })

    # Period ends from the balance sheet date line
    cy_end, py_end = None, None
    for r in range(1, 6):
        v = BS.cell(row=r, column=1).value
        if isinstance(v, str):
            m = re.search(r"(\d{4})年(\d{1,2})月(\d{1,2})日", v)
            if m:
                y, mo, d = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
                cy_end = "%04d-%02d-%02d" % (y, mo, d)
                py_end = "%04d-%02d-%02d" % (y - 1, mo, d)
                break

    eq_open_row = _find_row(EQ, "Beginning balance")
    eq_range = "%s%d:%s%d" % (
        _col_letter(min(colmap[EQ.title].values())), eq_open_row,
        _col_letter(max(colmap[EQ.title].values())), eq_open_row,
    )
    ignored = [{
        "sheet": EQ.title,
        "range": eq_range,
        "reason": "Opening retained earnings in the equity movement table: the current-year "
                  "figure repeats last year's closing balance and the prior-year figure is "
                  "not a template line; the template performs the roll-forward itself.",
    }]

    return {
        "entity_code": "TW-JP01",
        "source_entity_name": str(IS["A1"].value),
        "currency": "JPY",
        "unit": _unit(IS),
        "period_end": {"cy": cy_end, "py": py_end},
        "fields": fields,
        "source_totals": source_totals,
        "ignored": ignored,
        "source_exceptions": [],
        "notes": (
            "Workbook is in millions of yen (unit 1000000); column B is the prior year and "
            "column C the current year, detected from the headers. Miscellaneous income is "
            "mapped to other operating income and interest income to finance income; ordinary "
            "income therefore equals the template's profit before tax. Income tax expense is "
            "current plus deferred tax (the deferred line is a charge, as net income only "
            "reconciles that way). Capital stock and capital surplus are combined in share "
            "capital; accumulated other comprehensive income goes to other reserves. Dividends "
            "are shown negative in the equity table and are flipped with factor -1. 'Cash and "
            "deposits' is treated entirely as cash equivalents because it agrees with the cash "
            "flow ending balance. There are no investments or loans to group companies in the "
            "workbook. All printed totals tie and no source exceptions were found."
        ),
    }
```

You are helping Group Finance at the Tarnwell Group, a fictional company used in a demonstration.
Every subsidiary sends a year-end workbook in its own format. Group Finance publishes every subsidiary's
statements in one fixed group template. Write a Python adapter that reads ONE subsidiary's workbook and fills
the template's input lines. The template (layout, totals, PDF) is fixed and computes every total itself.

## The group template: 33 input lines, each for the current year (cy) and the prior year (py)
| key | statement | printed label | what belongs in it |
|---|---|---|---|
| revenue | IS / Profit or loss | Revenue | Sales of goods and services and management fees charged to other entities. |
| cost_of_sales | IS / Profit or loss | Cost of sales | Cost of goods sold or of services delivered. |
| distribution_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Distribution and selling costs | Selling, marketing and distribution expenses (the selling part of SG&A). |
| administrative_expenses | IS / Profit or loss | Administrative expenses | General and administrative expenses, including head-office staff, premises and other overheads. |
| other_operating_income | IS / Profit or loss | Other operating income (expense), net | Other operating and miscellaneous income less other operating and miscellaneous expenses, net. |
| finance_income | IS / Profit or loss | Finance income | Interest income, including interest on loans to group companies, and dividends received. |
| finance_costs | IS / Profit or loss | Finance costs | Interest on borrowings, overdrafts and lease liabilities. |
| income_tax_expense | IS / Profit or loss | Income tax expense | Current and deferred income tax on profit (a deferred tax credit reduces it). |
| property_plant_equipment | BS / Non-current assets | Property, plant and equipment | Land, buildings, plant, machinery, fixtures and equipment, net of depreciation. |
| right_of_use_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Right-of-use assets | Leased assets recognised on the balance sheet. |
| intangible_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Intangible assets and goodwill | Goodwill, software and other intangible assets, net of amortisation. |
| investments | BS / Non-current assets | Investments and loans to group companies | Investments in subsidiaries and other entities, and loans to group companies due after one year. |
| deferred_tax_assets | BS / Non-current assets | Deferred tax assets | Deferred tax assets, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in debtors). |
| inventories | BS / Current assets | Inventories | Raw materials, work in progress, finished goods and goods for resale. |
| trade_receivables | BS / Current assets | Trade receivables | Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected, net of allowances. |
| other_current_assets | BS / Current assets | Other current assets | Prepayments, other receivables, tax recoverable and bank deposits that are not cash equivalents (original maturity over three months). |
| cash_and_cash_equivalents | BS / Current assets | Cash and cash equivalents | Cash at bank and in hand and deposits that are cash equivalents. |
| trade_payables | BS / Current liabilities | Trade payables | Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services, all supplier categories together. |
| other_current_liabilities | BS / Current liabilities | Other current liabilities | Accruals, VAT and other taxes except income tax, payroll liabilities, employee profit sharing and deferred income. |
| current_borrowings | BS / Current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due within one year | Overdrafts, the current part of loans and the current part of lease liabilities. |
| current_tax_payable | BS / Current liabilities | Current income tax payable | Income tax payable. |
| non_current_borrowings | BS / Non-current liabilities | Borrowings and lease liabilities due after one year | Loans (including loans from group companies) and lease liabilities due after one year. |
| provisions | BS / Non-current liabilities | Provisions and employee benefit obligations | Long-term provisions, pension and retirement benefit obligations. |
| deferred_tax_liabilities | BS / Non-current liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities | Deferred tax liabilities, wherever the source shows them (some local formats put them in provisions). |
| share_capital | BS / Equity | Share capital and share premium | Issued share capital, share premium, capital surplus and additional paid-in capital. |
| retained_earnings | BS / Equity | Retained earnings | Accumulated profits after dividends, including profit for the year and profit reserves when shown separately. |
| other_reserves | BS / Equity | Other reserves | Translation reserve, other comprehensive income and other reserves. |
| net_cash_operating | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from operating activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_investing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from investing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| net_cash_financing | CF / Cash flows | Net cash from financing activities | Signed: inflow positive. |
| fx_effect_on_cash | CF / Cash flows | Effect of exchange rate changes on cash | Signed: gain positive. |
| cash_at_beginning | CF / Cash flows | Cash and cash equivalents at beginning of year | Opening cash. |
| dividends | EQ / Retained earnings | Dividends declared | Dividends declared to shareholders in the year, as a positive number. |

Sign rules: Report revenue, every expense, every asset and every liability as a positive number. Other operating income (expense), net is positive for net income and negative for net expense. Income tax expense is positive for a charge and negative for a credit. Cash flow lines are signed (inflow positive, outflow negative). Retained earnings and other reserves are signed (a deficit is negative). Dividends are positive.

Totals the template computes (never supply them; you may use these names in source_totals formulas):
- gross_profit = revenue - cost_of_sales
- operating_profit = gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses + other_operating_income
- profit_before_tax = operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs
- profit_for_year = profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense
- total_non_current_assets = property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets + investments + deferred_tax_assets
- total_current_assets = inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets + cash_and_cash_equivalents
- total_assets = total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets
- total_current_liabilities = trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings + current_tax_payable
- total_non_current_liabilities = non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities
- total_liabilities = total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities
- total_equity = share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves
- total_equity_and_liabilities = total_equity + total_liabilities
- net_change_in_cash = net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing
- cash_at_end = cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash

```python
import calendar
import math
import re
import unicodedata

import openpyxl


def extract(path) -> dict:
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)

    def normalise(value):
        return " ".join(unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", str(value)).split())

    def number(sheet, address):
        value = wb[sheet][address].value
        if (
            isinstance(value, bool)
            or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
            or not math.isfinite(value)
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"Expected a finite number at {sheet}!{address}")
        return value

    def row_for(sheet, label, after=0, before=None):
        ws = wb[sheet]
        stop = before if before is not None else ws.max_row + 1
        matches = [
            row
            for row in range(after + 1, stop)
            if normalise(ws.cell(row, 1).value) == normalise(label)
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Expected one row labelled {label!r} in {sheet}; found {matches}"
            )
        return matches[0]

    sheets = ("損益計算書", "貸借対照表", "CF計算書", "株主資本等変動")
    for sheet in sheets:
        if sheet not in wb.sheetnames:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing sheet: {sheet}")

    try:
        source_name = wb[sheets[0]]["A1"].value
        expected_name = "ターンウェル・ジャパン株式会社 (Tarnwell Japan KK)"
        if not isinstance(source_name, str):
            raise ValueError("Missing source entity name")
        for sheet in sheets:
            if normalise(wb[sheet]["A1"].value) != normalise(expected_name):
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected entity on {sheet}")

        # The legal entity identifies the register's JPY entity.
        # Each statement must explicitly declare millions of yen.
        for sheet in sheets:
            declarations = [
                normalise(cell.value)
                for row in wb[sheet].iter_rows()
                for cell in row
                if isinstance(cell.value, str) and "単位" in cell.value
            ]
            if declarations != [normalise("（単位：百万円）")]:
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected or ambiguous unit on {sheet}")

        columns = {}
        dates_by_sheet = {}
        for sheet in sheets:
            found = {}
            for row in wb[sheet].iter_rows():
                for cell in row:
                    if not isinstance(cell.value, str):
                        continue
                    text = normalise(cell.value)
                    match = re.fullmatch(
                        r"(前期|当期)\s*\((\d{4})年(\d{1,2})月期\)", text
                    )
                    if match:
                        year_key = "cy" if match.group(1) == "当期" else "py"
                        if year_key in found:
                            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate year header on {sheet}")
                        year, month = int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(3))
                        day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
                        found[year_key] = (
                            cell.column_letter,
                            f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}",
                        )
            if set(found) != {"cy", "py"}:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing year headers on {sheet}")
            columns[sheet] = {key: item[0] for key, item in found.items()}
            dates_by_sheet[sheet] = {key: item[1] for key, item in found.items()}

        period_end = dates_by_sheet["貸借対照表"]
        if any(dates != period_end for dates in dates_by_sheet.values()):
            raise ValueError("Statement dates disagree")

        keys = (
            "revenue cost_of_sales distribution_costs administrative_expenses "
            "other_operating_income finance_income finance_costs income_tax_expense "
            "property_plant_equipment right_of_use_assets intangible_assets investments "
            "deferred_tax_assets inventories trade_receivables other_current_assets "
            "cash_and_cash_equivalents trade_payables other_current_liabilities "
            "current_borrowings current_tax_payable non_current_borrowings provisions "
            "deferred_tax_liabilities share_capital retained_earnings other_reserves "
            "net_cash_operating net_cash_investing net_cash_financing fx_effect_on_cash "
            "cash_at_beginning dividends"
        ).split()
        fields = {
            key: {year: {"value": 0, "cells": []} for year in ("cy", "py")}
            for key in keys
        }
        source_totals = []
        accounted = set()

        def reference(sheet, row, year, factor=1):
            address = f"{columns[sheet][year]}{row}"
            number(sheet, address)
            accounted.add((sheet, address))
            return {"sheet": sheet, "cell": address, "factor": factor}

        def add_field(key, sheet, label, factor=1, after=0, before=None):
            row = row_for(sheet, label, after, before)
            for year in ("cy", "py"):
                ref = reference(sheet, row, year, factor)
                line = fields[key][year]
                line["cells"].append(ref)
                line["value"] += factor * number(sheet, ref["cell"])

        def add_total(sheet, label, formula):
            row = row_for(sheet, label)
            for year in ("cy", "py"):
                ref = reference(sheet, row, year)
                source_totals.append({**ref, "year": year, "formula": formula})

        income = "損益計算書"
        for key, label in (
            ("revenue", "売上高 Net sales"),
            ("cost_of_sales", "売上原価 Cost of sales"),
            ("distribution_costs", "販売費 Selling expenses"),
            ("administrative_expenses", "一般管理費 General and administrative"),
            ("other_operating_income", "雑収入 Miscellaneous income"),
            ("finance_income", "受取利息 Interest income"),
            ("finance_costs", "支払利息 Interest expense"),
            ("income_tax_expense", "法人税、住民税及び事業税 Current income taxes"),
            ("income_tax_expense", "法人税等調整額 Deferred income taxes"),
        ):
            add_field(key, income, label)

        for label, formula in (
            ("売上総利益 Gross profit", "gross_profit"),
            (
                "販売費及び一般管理費合計 Total SG&A",
                "distribution_costs + administrative_expenses",
            ),
            (
                "営業利益 Operating income",
                "operating_profit - other_operating_income",
            ),
            (
                "営業外収益合計 Total non-operating income",
                "finance_income + other_operating_income",
            ),
            ("経常利益 Ordinary income", "profit_before_tax"),
            ("税引前当期純利益 Income before income taxes", "profit_before_tax"),
            ("当期純利益 Net income", "profit_for_year"),
        ):
            add_total(income, label, formula)

        balance = "貸借対照表"
        for key, label in (
            ("inventories", "棚卸資産 Inventories"),
            ("trade_receivables", "売掛金 Accounts receivable"),
            ("cash_and_cash_equivalents", "現金及び預金 Cash and deposits"),
            ("property_plant_equipment", "有形固定資産 Property and equipment"),
            ("right_of_use_assets", "使用権資産 Right-of-use assets"),
            ("intangible_assets", "無形固定資産 Intangible assets"),
            ("deferred_tax_assets", "繰延税金資産 Deferred tax assets"),
            ("trade_payables", "買掛金 Accounts payable"),
            ("current_borrowings", "短期借入金 Short-term loans"),
            ("current_tax_payable", "未払法人税等 Income taxes payable"),
            ("non_current_borrowings", "長期借入金 Long-term loans"),
            ("provisions", "退職給付に係る負債 Retirement benefit liability"),
            ("deferred_tax_liabilities", "繰延税金負債 Deferred tax liabilities"),
            ("share_capital", "資本金 Capital stock"),
            ("share_capital", "資本剰余金 Capital surplus"),
            ("retained_earnings", "利益剰余金 Retained earnings"),
            (
                "other_reserves",
                "その他の包括利益累計額 Accumulated other comprehensive income",
            ),
        ):
            add_field(key, balance, label)

        for key, start_label, end_label in (
            (
                "other_current_assets",
                "流動資産 Current assets",
                "流動資産合計 Total current assets",
            ),
            (
                "other_current_liabilities",
                "流動負債 Current liabilities",
                "流動負債合計 Total current liabilities",
            ),
        ):
            add_field(
                key,
                balance,
                "その他 Other",
                after=row_for(balance, start_label),
                before=row_for(balance, end_label),
            )

        for label, formula in (
            ("流動資産合計 Total current assets", "total_current_assets"),
            ("固定資産合計 Total non-current assets", "total_non_current_assets"),
            ("資産合計 Total assets", "total_assets"),
            ("流動負債合計 Total current liabilities", "total_current_liabilities"),
            ("負債合計 Total liabilities", "total_liabilities"),
            ("純資産合計 Total net assets", "total_equity"),
            (
                "負債純資産合計 Total liabilities and net assets",
                "total_equity_and_liabilities",
            ),
        ):
            add_total(balance, label, formula)

        cashflow = "CF計算書"
        for key, label in (
            ("net_cash_operating", "営業活動によるキャッシュ・フロー Operating activities"),
            ("net_cash_investing", "投資活動によるキャッシュ・フロー Investing activities"),
            ("net_cash_financing", "財務活動によるキャッシュ・フロー Financing activities"),
            ("fx_effect_on_cash", "現金及び現金同等物に係る換算差額 FX effect"),
            ("cash_at_beginning", "現金及び現金同等物の期首残高 Beginning balance"),
        ):
            add_field(key, cashflow, label)
        add_total(
            cashflow, "現金及び現金同等物の増減額 Net change", "net_change_in_cash"
        )
        add_total(
            cashflow, "現金及び現金同等物の期末残高 Ending balance", "cash_at_end"
        )

        equity = "株主資本等変動"
        add_field("dividends", equity, "剰余金の配当 Dividends", factor=-1)
        for label, formula in (
            (
                "当期首残高 Beginning balance",
                "retained_earnings - profit_for_year + dividends",
            ),
            ("当期純利益 Net income", "profit_for_year"),
            ("当期末残高 Ending balance", "retained_earnings"),
        ):
            add_total(equity, label, formula)

        total_formulas = {
            "gross_profit": "revenue - cost_of_sales",
            "operating_profit": (
                "gross_profit - distribution_costs - administrative_expenses "
                "+ other_operating_income"
            ),
            "profit_before_tax": "operating_profit + finance_income - finance_costs",
            "profit_for_year": "profit_before_tax - income_tax_expense",
            "total_non_current_assets": (
                "property_plant_equipment + right_of_use_assets + intangible_assets "
                "+ investments + deferred_tax_assets"
            ),
            "total_current_assets": (
                "inventories + trade_receivables + other_current_assets "
                "+ cash_and_cash_equivalents"
            ),
            "total_assets": "total_non_current_assets + total_current_assets",
            "total_current_liabilities": (
                "trade_payables + other_current_liabilities + current_borrowings "
                "+ current_tax_payable"
            ),
            "total_non_current_liabilities": (
                "non_current_borrowings + provisions + deferred_tax_liabilities"
            ),
            "total_liabilities": (
                "total_current_liabilities + total_non_current_liabilities"
            ),
            "total_equity": "share_capital + retained_earnings + other_reserves",
            "total_equity_and_liabilities": "total_equity + total_liabilities",
            "net_change_in_cash": (
                "net_cash_operating + net_cash_investing + net_cash_financing"
            ),
            "cash_at_end": "cash_at_beginning + net_change_in_cash + fx_effect_on_cash",
        }

        def evaluate(expression, values):
            tokens = expression.split()
            if len(tokens) % 2 != 1 or tokens[0] not in values:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid formula: {expression}")
            result = values[tokens[0]]
            for index in range(1, len(tokens), 2):
                operator, name = tokens[index:index + 2]
                if operator not in ("+", "-") or name not in values:
                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid formula: {expression}")
                result += values[name] if operator == "+" else -values[name]
            return result

        computed = {}
        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            values = {key: fields[key][year]["value"] for key in keys}
            for key, expression in total_formulas.items():
                values[key] = evaluate(expression, values)
            computed[year] = values

        exceptions = []

        def check(check_id, difference, explanation):
            if not math.isclose(difference, 0, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-9):
                exceptions.append({
                    "check": check_id,
                    "difference": difference,
                    "explanation": explanation,
                })

        for total in source_totals:
            actual = total["factor"] * number(total["sheet"], total["cell"])
            expected = evaluate(total["formula"], computed[total["year"]])
            check(
                f"T {total['sheet']}!{total['cell']} {total['year']}",
                actual - expected,
                "Printed amount minus the mapped template expression "
                f"({total['formula']}); source amounts are preserved.",
            )

        for year in ("cy", "py"):
            values = computed[year]
            check(
                f"R1 balance {year}",
                values["total_assets"] - values["total_equity_and_liabilities"],
                "Total assets minus total equity and liabilities.",
            )
            check(
                f"R2 cash_at_end {year}",
                values["cash_at_end"] - values["cash_and_cash_equivalents"],
                "Cash-flow closing cash minus balance-sheet cash.",
            )

        check(
            "R3 opening cash cy",
            computed["cy"]["cash_at_beginning"]
            - computed["py"]["cash_and_cash_equivalents"],
            "Current-year opening cash minus prior-year balance-sheet cash.",
        )
        check(
            "R4 retained earnings cy",
            computed["py"]["retained_earnings"]
            + computed["cy"]["profit_for_year"]
            - computed["cy"]["dividends"]
            - computed["cy"]["retained_earnings"],
            "Prior retained earnings plus current profit less dividends "
            "minus current retained earnings.",
        )

        # Fail explicitly if a changed workbook introduces an unclassified amount.
        for sheet in sheets:
            ws = wb[sheet]
            for column in set(columns[sheet].values()):
                used_rows = [
                    ws[address].row
                    for used_sheet, address in accounted
                    if used_sheet == sheet
                    and ws[address].column_letter == column
                ]
                for row in range(min(used_rows), ws.max_row + 1):
                    cell = ws[f"{column}{row}"]
                    if (
                        isinstance(cell.value, (int, float))
                        and not isinstance(cell.value, bool)
                        and (sheet, cell.coordinate) not in accounted
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unclassified numeric amount: {sheet}!{cell.coordinate}"
                        )

        return {
            "entity_code": "TW-JP01",
            "source_entity_name": source_name,
            "currency": "JPY",
            "unit": 1000000,
            "period_end": period_end,
            "fields": fields,
            "source_totals": source_totals,
            "ignored": [],
            "source_exceptions": exceptions,
            "notes": (
                "The workbook identifies Tarnwell Japan K.K.; amounts remain in "
                "millions of JPY. Miscellaneous income is mapped to other operating "
                "income, so Japanese operating income is checked against group "
                "operating profit less that income. Capital surplus is combined "
                "with capital stock; accumulated OCI retains its sign. Cash and "
                "deposits is treated as cash equivalents because both years agree "
                "with the cash-flow closing balances and no restricted or longer-term "
                "deposits are identified. Dividend outflows are sign-reversed. "
                "Investments and other absent input lines are zero with no citations. "
                "The retained-earnings schedule's opening balances are checked against "
                "closing retained earnings less profit plus dividends."
            ),
        }
    finally:
        wb.close()
```
